title: Semantius translation work file
description: What one language still needs, in one file, for a translator (usually an agent) to fill in. Written by apps/web/scripts/i18n/translate.mjs into apps/web/.i18n/ (git-ignored) and read back by import.mjs. Every entry carries its English source and the placeholders it has to keep; `translation` is the only field to edit.

locale.description: The catalog language being translated, e.g. de-DE.

generated.description: When the file was produced. Informational.

entries.description: The work: one entry per key in the index that the language has no translation for.

key.description: The stored key. For a code string, the English source text itself (a disambiguated one is prefixed, `columnVisibility.View`); for model text, the model path under `module.`; for a server error, its code.

source.description: The English (or, for a server sentence, the original) text to translate.

translation.description: FILL THIS IN. Empty means still untranslated; import.mjs skips it.

comment.description: A note the developer left for the translator.

placeholders.description: The ICU placeholders the source uses. The translation MUST use exactly these — import.mjs refuses the file otherwise, because a dropped placeholder loses data on screen and an invented one renders as literal braces.
